name: Caina Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Caina Technology Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of a variety of medical devices, particularly those related to injections and fluid delivery. The company's product portfolio includes essential sterile and single-use items such as safe, self-destructing syringes, disposable insulin syringes, and sterile insulin pen needles. They also provide sterile needles for blood collection and other specialized sterile medical instruments. Established in 2004, Caina Technology operates from its base in Jiangyin, China.
